thread:
Irene: Aurelia Health pilot stalled. Python SDK streaming connects but function-calls (structured JSON tool outputs) are arriving as text frames they can't parse. Theyneed a quick patch and a short security/pricing summary for their procurement team.
Jamal: Python SDK can emit tool-call frames properly, but older client versions fallback to plain text. Which SDK version are they on?
Irene: They're on 0.9.2 pinned by their ops.
Tess: 0.9.2 predates the function-call frame stabilization. Short-term fix: run our proxy that normalizes frames into POST webhooks they already accept. No code change.
Carlos: Proxy config (minimal):
```
proxy:
  ingress: https://aurelia-proxy.local:443
  mode: normalize
  forward_toolcalls_as: webhook
  webhook_url: http://127.0.0.1:9000/tool
```
This turns function-call frames into structured POSTs.
Irene: Perfect. Can we also get a one-pager: hosted pricing vs 12mo Dedicated for bursty traffic (peak 600 RPS for short windows, avg 40 RPS)? Procurement wants simple numbers.
Jamal: I'll prepare ranges. Note: hosted generation tier varies by model; rough hosted ballpark $0.0007-0.0010/token. Dedicated pricing depends on reserved GPU class + network. Will include assumptions (avg tokens/response, cache hit-rate).
Tess: Security Qs: they asked about KMS integration, SAML, retention for audit logs, and whether the proxy can be deployed in their VPC. Answer: yes/yes/yes/yes. Will add short notes on cert pinning and short-lived creds.
deploy-bot: Created ticket AH-3021 for proxy deploy and docs handoff (assignee: Tess).
Carlos: Also include our structured-output schema (sample payloads) so their ingestion team can validate. Example: {"tool":"redact","result":{"fields":[{"name":"ssn","value":"***"}]}}
Irene: Timeline: proxy + sample payloads today, pricing one-pager + checklist by tomorrow AM. Can team commit?
Jamal: I can draft the pricing ranges tonight.
Tess: I'll push a tiny docker-compose with the proxy and sample webhook.
Carlos: I'll extract the structured-output spec and a couple of sample payloads.
Irene: Thanks. I'll coordinate the email to Aurelia and propose a call after they validate samples. :thumbsup:
